text:
Gold Price in 1970
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1970, the LBMA gold price rose 6.8% between 1970-01-30 ($34.99) and 1970-12-31 ($37.38). The highest sampled price was $37.54 in November and the lowest was $34.99 in January. The mean of these observations was $35.98. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
